text:
Ava (Design): Hey team — dropped a new iteration of the Alerts & SLO Config panel in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/alerts-slo-notify-preview. Main change is a collapsed 'Notification preview' rail + a compact suppression editor. Looking for quick UX + copy + accessibility nits. Sam (UX Writer): I like the compact rail. Copy note: change "Test notification" to "Send test" (more action-y). Also the placeholder for threshold feels vague: instead of "Set threshold" use "Trigger when error rate >". Diego (Frontend): Visual: the preview has a small avatar + 2-line message. Can we make the channel badge clickable to open channel config? Implementation wise, generating live previews for every channel might be heavy. Maybe preview shows a dropdown to pick channel, default to the last-used. Priya (PM): +1 on dropdown. Also we should surface which notification integrations are required to be configured (Slack vs PagerDuty). For suppression, can we default to a 15m auto-snooze for alerts triggered by rollout events? Ops asked for that. accessibility-bot: Automated scan: contrast issue on severity chips (orange #FFB84D on white) — fails AA large text. Suggested fix: darken to #E08A00 or add 2px stroke. Also missing aria-label on the preview iframe. Noah (DevEx): For keyboard nav, the collapsed rail needs to be tabbable and announceable. Suggested ARIA snippet: ```
...
``` Ava (Design): Good catches. Sam — can you propose the copy strings? Diego — I'll update the dropdown affordance. Noah — put the aria snippet in the component props doc. Sam (UX Writer): Draft copy suggestions: [Preview rail header] "Notification preview"; [preview empty state] "No channels connected — connect a channel to preview notifications"; [suppress control label] "Suppression window (min)" with helper text "Temporarily mute alerts for N minutes after firing". Thoughts? Diego (Frontend): Copy looks fine. For suppression UI: using a number input + quick presets (15m, 1h, 24h) is nicer than a slider for accessibility. Sliders are bad for precise minutes. Also need to persist the last preset per-project. Priya (PM): Agreed on presets. Also we should show an inline example of what suppression does: "If an alert fires again within the suppression window it will not create a new incident, but will append to the existing incident" — that should reduce confusion. Ava (Design): Good call. UX nit: change the suppression label from "Snooze" to "Suppression window" to avoid implying user action (snooze feels manual). Add a tiny info icon with the one-line example. accessibility-bot: Additional: ensure contrast for primary CTA (purple #6B46FF) meets AA for normal text. Passes in current palette but verify on hover state. Ensure focus ring is >= 3px visible. Noah (DevEx): One more dev constraint: live templating for Slack + email + PD in preview requires renderer code for each integration. Proposal: render a canonical plain-text + Slack block for active channel only; show a static email mock. That keeps API calls minimal and makes caching trivial. Sam (UX Writer): Copy tweak for preview header when multiple channels selected: "Preview (showing Slack)", with the ability to switch — avoids confusion. Diego (Frontend): Implementation plan: 1) dropdown to select channel type, 2) client-side templates for Slack/email/PD, 3) cache sample payloads per workspace, 4) test button will call a background job to actually send (opt-in). Will add feature flags. Priya (PM): Prioritize: presets + copy + ARIA + channel dropdown for next sprint. Test-send can be behind feature flag. Can we ship accessible number input + presets first? Ava (Design): Plan for follow-ups: I'll update Figma with presets + helper text + new copy, and add contrast tweaks to severity chips. Action items: Sam to finalize strings, Noah to add ARIA props, Diego to prototype dropdown behavior, Priya to confirm default suppression policy with Ops. Sam (UX Writer): I'll post final strings later today. :memo: Diego (Frontend): I'll sketch the dropdown states and tab order by EOD. Noah (DevEx): I'll add the aria example to the component doc and run accessibility smoke tests after the prototype. Priya (PM): Thanks y'all. If anyone wants to demo in design review tomorrow ping me. :rocket: Ava (Design): Thanks — closing thread once Figma is updated. :white_check_mark:
